function.arguments: {"observed_effect": "unchanged", "distance_only_hypothesis": "unsupported", "light_change": "no", "evidence": "In the wrist view the button box center moved from (0.30,0.065) to (0.2625,0.065) while the contact tip stayed at (0.70,0.76), so the lateral error grew from -0.40 to -0.44 button-box units and the vertical error stayed at -0.695, with no visible button illumination change.", "alternative_explanation": "The repeated +5 mm X commands may be moving the wrist laterally away from the button or changing the camera pose/parallax rather than closing the true 3D gap, so the apparent forward distance is not the only remaining issue.", "next_check": "Take a new wrist image after a small lateral correction toward the button and check whether the button-box center and contact-tip separation decrease in both x and y, or whether the button edge visibly depresses/illuminates."}
